chunks: From him, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
“Indeed, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbade that soil not taken out from the grave be added onto the grave.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, the Imam transmitting the report
key_terms.النَّبِيَّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.لَمْ يُخْرَجْ مِنْهُ: that was not taken out from it, i.e., from the grave itself

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbid regarding adding soil to a grave?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a prohibition from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding adding outside soil onto a grave. It indicates an Islamic legal ruling connected to burial practice and the proper treatment of graves.
